methods.name: Radial basis function (RBF) interpolation for DEM generation
methods.summary: The authors implemented various radial basis function (RBF) interpolation methods (multiquadric, inverse multiquadric, thin plate spline, and natural cubic spline) to convert UAV-derived point clouds into raster digital elevation models (DEMs) for landslide detection and displacement analysis.
methods.source: Authors' own implementation in R and Surfer software
methods.verbatim: The methods and analysis were implemented in R (R Core Team 2017) and Surfer software (Golden Software, Inc.).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for DEM generation lacks a repository or persistent link.
